document.title: Accept valid reviews in two eval cases
document.summary: comprehende-39 no longer rejects one group that holds exec.ts and skill-sync.ts. A commit label matches its subject when the only difference is one trailing period.
document.why: The graded suite on main after #113 fails comprehende-39 and comprehende-47. [That run](source:s1) asks for a fix when the produced review is valid.

commits.subject: Match commit source labels that omit a final period.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
PR 47's subject is "Replace document tickets with first-class sources." The producer copied it without the period, and the source check treated that as an unknown commit.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Drop the comprehende-39 apart pair.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
PR 39 changes skill-sync.ts only to pass gitEnv into its own git calls. Holding that file with src/git/exec.ts is one review concern. The apart expect made that grouping a hard fail. Earlier graded runs split the call site out; both groupings follow the skill.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
